description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No.520001 (23/1025).
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed property descriptions, cadastral references, owner information, and land registration particulars. The document is explicitly published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses on land ownership registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
